Fear.note: On the one player the Fearmonger currently has chosen.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: The Fearmonger may choose a new player.

full.text: The Fearmonger chooses a player: move *FEAR* to them. If it moved to a different player, announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
full.reason: Says the Fear token moves to tonight’s choice.
